gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-martian-mono: Martian Mono spaces its fixed-width, code-style letters generously, with wide openings in every curve, under Pramukh Rounded's tightly packed headline shapes. Tight against loose is the whole story here.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-montagu-slab: Friendly and snug, Pramukh Rounded sets the tone up top. Montagu Slab follows in a serif with sturdy downstrokes, slender turns and a generous x-height that keeps the text easy on screen.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-noto-serif-hen: Refined and a touch traditional, Noto Serif Hentaigana takes over below Pramukh Rounded's tight heading. Its serif strokes slim visibly yet stay sturdy, so a long passage moves along with steady, gentle texture.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-ovo: Pramukh Rounded packs its glyphs close, with bowls open like a tipped ladle and large lowercase forms up top. Ovo, a serif, then reads with a faint felt-marker swell and an authoritative, spacious feel.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-victor-mono: Victor Mono reads precise and loose, a monospace whose bowls stay unfinished on one side and whose spacing runs wide. Pramukh Rounded's tight, friendly heading shapes sit above it, and the true monoline drawing below makes the gap in spacing obvious.
gen-fs-quilon-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab reads grounded and refined, a serif whose lowercase letters all stand tall, and it suits taking in gently. Quilon's display heading adds a flowing stroke and wide counters, and its slightly lighter joins sit lightly above the body.
gen-fs-quilon-fs-trench-slab: Quilon brings an editorial, commanding display voice, with strokes that swell and ease and generous counters in its tall a, e and s. Trench Slab keeps a dignified classic serif tone, with capitals sitting close to the lowercase height, so it suits a handful of lines.
gen-fs-rajdhani-gf-hepta-slab: Rajdhani is modern and clean, drawing every curve as thick as its straight stems and packing text into dense strips. Hepta Slab, a serif, then stretches out its words with open counters, so a long passage feels bookish and unhurried.
gen-fs-rajdhani-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru reads editorial and traditional, a text serif with generous letterspace, terminals that stop well short of the stem and perfectly ringed o shapes. Beneath it, Rajdhani's dense, modern headline strips give a tight, clean counterpoint.
gen-fs-rajdhani-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Padyakke Expanded One spreads its glyphs wide, like knots on a slack rope, with a pitcher-mouthed c in each line. Rajdhani, tight and modern, makes the strongest contrast: dense and compact against that wide, authoritative serif.
